title: Theme surface renders light/dark/system radiogroup when application-spa applied
asA: authenticated principal on an SPA project
iWant: a theme surface with a light, dark and system option persisted per the theme-persistence elicit
soThat: my theme choice sticks the way the project decided

acceptanceCriteria.description: When application-spa is in the applied-blueprint set, GET /account/theme renders <div data-surface="theme" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Theme"> containing three <input type="radio" name="theme" value="light|dark|system"> options; selecting an option flips the data-theme attribute on the html element and persists per the theme-persistence elicit (spa-local-storage default, server-scoped, or none). Probed by pack check AC-25108-1.

The theme surface renders a radiogroup with exactly three options (light, dark, system) using role="radiogroup" and role="radio", each with an accessible name; a break that omits a radio fails the pack.
acceptanceCriteria.given: application-spa applied and the theme route renders
acceptanceCriteria.then: the theme control is a radiogroup with three radios named light, dark and system

acceptanceCriteria.description: When theme-persistence is spa-local-storage, the theme choice persists across principal loads via localStorage; when server-scoped, the choice persists via the applied server endpoint; when none, the choice resets to system on load.
acceptanceCriteria.given: each theme-persistence value applied in turn
acceptanceCriteria.when: the principal picks a theme and reloads
acceptanceCriteria.then: spa-local-storage persists via localStorage, server-scoped persists via the server endpoint, none resets to system
